title: Forecasting Farmer Prices (FAOSTAT)
summary: A machine-learning project forecasting agricultural Producer Price Index (PPI) by country and crop from FAOSTAT panel data, using cleaning, PostgreSQL integration, imputation, and comparative LightGBM/neural-net models. SDV's TVAESynthesizer, via the sdv.single_table API, is run on dataset_1_second.ipynb to impute item-independent columns alongside LightGBM and KNN methods.
